title: CONSENT TO ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION AND FIRST AMENDMENT OF AGREEMENT NO. 26-10200 FROM GRAVITON CONSULTING SERVICES, INC. TO GRAVITON CONSULTING SERVICES, LLC
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - CONSENT TO ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION AND FIRST AMENDMENT OF AGREEMENT NO. 26-10200 FROM GRAVITON CONSULTING SERVICES, INC. TO GRAVITON CONSULTING SERVICES, LLC
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the Consent to Assignment and Assumption (Assignment) and First Amendment (Amendment) to Agreement No. 26-10200 (Agreement) from Graviton Consulting Services, Inc. (Graviton Inc.) to Graviton Consulting Services, LLC (Graviton LLC). This Agreement is in alignment with Strategic Plan Objective 3: Improved Financial Performance of Port Assets. The Assignment of the Agreement will allow Graviton LLC to continue to provide Managed Services Support for the Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) System. This Assignment is necessary due to the acquisition of Graviton LLC by Highstreet IT Solutions, LLC which obtained 100% ownership of Graviton LLC, effective February 27, 2026. All terms and conditions of the Agreement will remain unchanged. The City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) will continue to be financially responsible for payment of expenses incurred under the Agreement.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the Consent to Assignment and Assumption and First Amendment to Agreement No. 26 10200 from Graviton Consulting Services, Inc. to Graviton Consulting Services, LLC, retroactively effective February 27, 2026; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the Consent to Assignment and Assumption and First Amendment to Agreement No. 26 10200 for and on behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No. ____________.
Construction & Maintenance
summary: Approval of assignment and first amendment to Graviton Consulting Services agreement allowing continuation of managed services for Port Enterprise Resource Planning system following acquisition by Highstreet IT Solutions.
